Silom prilika, tokom septembra bila sam više puta u Milmedika,Budva,ujutro,uveče, vikendom. Moram da kažem da su svi zaposleni, doktori, a sestre naročito,bili izuzetno ljubazni,predusretljivi,stručni, puni empatije,čime su mi znatno olakšali svakodnevni boravak u prostorijama Milmedike (5 inhalacija, 10 infuzija,više puta vadjenje krvi,nekoliko lekarskih pregleda,). Svi su bili divni, nažalost nisam ih pitala za imena, samo sam zapamtila Stefana, Filipa i mislim da se jedna od sestara zove Tamara ili Tanja, ali zaista su svi zaposleni tamo PREDIVNI i ja im ovim putem zahvaljujem na trudu i požrtvovanju. Uprkos mojoj bolesti, u današnje vreme jedno divno iskustvo kako medicinska usluga treba i može da izgleda.

My partner suffered from vomiting and diarrhoea (food poisoning) and we had to bring him to A&E at medical centre kotor. We were the only ones there but it was a small hospital so they could only give IV fluids and some antiemetics. We then went to this clinic for a proper assessment - they took bloods and administer IV fluids and antibiotics promptly! Don’t know what we would do without a service like that for tourists, especially since we were flying back to the UK soon. Highly recommend the professionalism and prompt treatment from this team 🙏🏻🙏🏻
Vrhunski profesionalci. Svaka preporuka.

Very friendly. Although many people were waiting the staff took care of my wife very quickly. Went there for a painful infection. Saw a doctor within 15 minutes, took blood and other samples and got results within another 15 minutes. We were out the door within 45 with prescriptions to the pharmacy around the corner. Reception even called us a taxi. Also very fair priced. Thanks for the quick and friendly help.
Ich bin mit einer Lebensmittelvergiftung während meinem Urlaub dort hin und habe auch direkt Hilfe bekommen. Nach paar Infusionen ging es mir besser. Nettes Personal und professionell gearbeitet.

Хочу відмітити, що ціни на медичні послуги прийнятні, в клініці можна пройти УЗД, отримати інʼєкції або крапельниці.
Дуже дякую фахівцям цієї клініки, що швидко надали адекватну допомогу і зберегли мені відпуску!!!
Très bon accueil.  Pas d attente. Tous les examens et soins sont faits sur place. Top

We visited Milmedika Budva on a Sunday with our six year old son, who had a fever and severe cough. Despite the clinic being packed and under heavy pressure, the team welcomed us with incredible calm, warmth, and professionalism.
Nurses Spasenja Đukanović and Svetlana Vujanović were phenomenal. Their kindness, patience, and gentle approach immediately put our son at ease and brought us immense peace of mind. A special thank you goes to pediatrician Dr. Ana Lopičić Kašćelan - an exceptional specialist and a wonderful person whose thoroughness, warmth, and dedication set a standard every pediatrician should follow.
The organization was seamless: blood work and CRP were completed on-site without delay, followed immediately by a follow-up review and an appropriate treatment plan.
We live in Germany and have experienced healthcare facilities across Europe and around the world, but this rare combination of speed, clinical expertise, and heartfelt compassion truly exceeds global standards. Highest recommendations and sincere thanks to the entire team!
